text_summary.body: Nebuchadnezzar made Mattaniah, Jehoiachin's uncle, king and renamed him Zedekiah; twenty-one, he reigned eleven years, did evil, and rebelled against Babylon.

setting.body: ABC 5 records that Nebuchadnezzar "appointed there a king of his own choice" after capturing the city.

constraints.subject: evt_01M4V7CG4K5GDX8CFDC7BWPCXZ
constraints.textual_assertion: The king of Babylon made Mattaniah … king in his place
assumptions: ABC 5 records the appointment in the same entry as the capture; the 45-day margin covers the "turn of the year" (2 Chr 36:10).

commentary.paraphrase: Guzik notes that Mattaniah was renamed Zedekiah and reigned eleven years.

not_applicable.competing_reconstructions: The installation itself is not disputed; the end of the reign is treated under the fall of Jerusalem.
